cobblebash.configuration.title: CobbleBash Configs
cobblebash.dialogue.battle_format.double: This will be a Double Battle. Two Pokémon may fight at once!
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.boss.line_1: Every tiny opening becomes a swarm. Show me you can survive one.
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.boss.name: The Hive Queen
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.trainer_1.line_1: Welcome to the Bug gym. The web is already set, so step carefully.
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.trainer_1.name: The Trapper
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.trainer_2.line_1: Small wings, sharp instincts. Let us see if you can keep up.
cobblebash.dialogue.bug.trainer_2.name: The Swarm
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.boss.line_1: No more warnings. Step forward, and bring your nerve with you.
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.boss.name: Dark Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.trainer_1.line_: The Dark gym begins here. Keep your nerve where the light thins.
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.trainer_1.name: Dark Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.trainer_2.line_: Keep your eyes open. The nastiest tricks happen in plain sight.
cobblebash.dialogue.dark.trainer_2.name: Dark Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.dragon.boss.line_1: Stand tall. Dragons only respect challengers who refuse to bow.
cobblebash.dialogue.dragon.boss.name: Dragon Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.dragon.trainer_1.lin: The Dragon gym begins here. Show me the courage behind your roar.
cobblebash.dialogue.dragon.trainer_2.lin: A dragon battle is decided before the first roar fades.
cobblebash.dialogue.electric.boss.line_1: I want to see if your spark can survive a storm.
cobblebash.dialogue.electric.boss.name: Electric Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.electric.trainer_1.l: The Electric gym begins here. One spark is all it takes.
cobblebash.dialogue.electric.trainer_2.l: One wrong step and this match is over in a flash.
cobblebash.dialogue.elite4_champion.boss: You have reached your final challenge, Trainer. Prove you are worthy of the Champion's crown.
cobblebash.dialogue.elite4_electric_grou: The ground remembers every storm. Prove you can stand in both.
cobblebash.dialogue.elite4_fire_fairy.bo: Flame reveals the shape of courage. Light reveals what is left.
cobblebash.dialogue.elite4_grass_ghost.b: Every victory decays. Every defeat takes root.
cobblebash.dialogue.elite4_water_steel.b: Steel bends in the deep. The tide does not.
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.boss.line_1: Charm, mischief, and power. You will need answers for all three.
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.boss.name: Fairy Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.trainer_1.line: The Fairy gym begins here. Pretty moves can still bite.
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.trainer_1.name: Fairy Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.trainer_2.line: A pretty move can still hit like a hammer.
cobblebash.dialogue.fairy.trainer_2.name: Fairy Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.fighting.boss.line_1: Words are done. Show me the strength behind your training.
cobblebash.dialogue.fighting.boss.name: Fighting Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.fighting.trainer_1.l: The Fighting gym begins here. Show me your opening move.
cobblebash.dialogue.fighting.trainer_2.l: Plant your feet. If your stance breaks, so will your team.
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.boss.line_1: If your resolve burns clean, you may leave here with my badge.
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.boss.name: The Ash King
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.trainer_1.line_: The Fire gym begins here. Every blaze starts with a spark.
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.trainer_1.name: The Kindler
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.trainer_2.line_: Heat alone is nothing. Control is what wins battles.
cobblebash.dialogue.fire.trainer_2.name: The Furnace
cobblebash.dialogue.flying.boss.line_1: Meet me at the edge of the sky and prove you will not fall.
cobblebash.dialogue.flying.boss.name: Flying Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.flying.trainer_1.lin: The Flying gym begins here. Keep your footing when the wind rises.
cobblebash.dialogue.flying.trainer_2.lin: Up here, hesitation drops faster than any Pokemon.
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.boss.line_1: The brave do not fear shadows. They learn what waits inside them.
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.boss.name: Ghost Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.trainer_1.line: The Ghost gym begins here. Do not let the silence fool you.
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.trainer_1.name: Ghost Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.trainer_2.line: Do not trust the silence. That is when ghosts move first.
cobblebash.dialogue.ghost.trainer_2.name: Ghost Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.boss.line_1: Growth takes patience. Victory takes roots strong enough to hold.
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.boss.name: Grass Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.trainer_1.line: The Grass gym begins here. Roots first, then victory.
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.trainer_1.name: Grass Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.trainer_2.line: Roots hold. Vines pull. Let us see where you stand.
cobblebash.dialogue.grass.trainer_2.name: Grass Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.ground.boss.line_1: The earth does not move for anyone. Make it move for you.
cobblebash.dialogue.ground.boss.name: Ground Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.ground.trainer_1.lin: The Ground gym begins here. Watch your step.
cobblebash.dialogue.ground.trainer_2.lin: The arena remembers every careless step.
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.boss.line_1: One calm breath. One clean strike. That is all the cold allows.
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.boss.name: Ice Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.trainer_1.line_1: The Ice gym begins here. Stay calm, or crack.
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.trainer_1.name: Ice Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.trainer_2.line_1: Stay calm. Panic cracks faster than thin ice.
cobblebash.dialogue.ice.trainer_2.name: Ice Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.normal.boss.line_1: Simple does not mean easy. Let us settle this properly.
cobblebash.dialogue.normal.boss.name: Normal Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.normal.trainer_1.lin: The Normal gym begins here. No tricks, just battle sense.
cobblebash.dialogue.normal.trainer_2.lin: No tricks here. Just clean reads and sharper timing.
cobblebash.dialogue.poison.boss.line_1: Endure the venom, read the pattern, and maybe you earn the badge.
cobblebash.dialogue.poison.boss.name: Poison Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.poison.trainer_1.lin: The Poison gym begins here. One careless move is all it takes.
cobblebash.dialogue.poison.trainer_2.lin: The first mistake stings. The second one decides it.
cobblebash.dialogue.psychic.boss.line_1: Mind against mind, then. Try to surprise me.
cobblebash.dialogue.psychic.boss.name: Psychic Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.psychic.trainer_1.li: The Psychic gym begins here. Think carefully before you move.
cobblebash.dialogue.psychic.trainer_2.li: If I know your move before you make it, is it still yours?
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.boss.line_1: If your team can weather this, the badge is yours.
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.boss.name: Rock Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.trainer_1.line_: The Rock gym begins here. Stand firm or be broken.
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.trainer_1.name: Rock Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.trainer_2.line_: Pressure makes stone, but it also breaks weak teams.
cobblebash.dialogue.rock.trainer_2.name: Rock Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.boss.line_1: I have tempered this team for challengers like you.
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.boss.name: Steel Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.trainer_1.line: The Steel gym begins here. Every strike is tested here.
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.trainer_1.name: Steel Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.trainer_2.line: Steel does not rush. Steel waits for the perfect strike.
cobblebash.dialogue.steel.trainer_2.name: Steel Trainer 2
cobblebash.dialogue.water.boss.line_1: Flow with the battle or be swept out of it.
cobblebash.dialogue.water.boss.name: Water Boss
cobblebash.dialogue.water.trainer_1.line: The Water gym begins here. Flow with the battle or be swept away.
cobblebash.dialogue.water.trainer_1.name: Water Trainer 1
cobblebash.dialogue.water.trainer_2.line: The tide turns slowly, then all at once.
cobblebash.dialogue.water.trainer_2.name: Water Trainer 2
